newsitem.title: RUSSIA: S&P, IBCA to come to St. Petersburg in Feb-Mar.
newsitem.headline: S&P, IBCA to come to St. Petersburg in Feb-Mar.

text.p: Officials from International rating agencies Standard & Poor's and IBCA will visit St Petersburg at the end of February or start of March to assess the city ahead of its planned Eurobond, a municipal Finance Committee spokeswoman said on Friday.
It will be their first visit to the city, Olga Pokrovskaya told Reuters.
In November 1996 St Petersburg governor Vladimir Yakovlev ordered the committee to sign a contract with either Standard & Poor's or Moody's to get an international credit rating.
The City of St Petersburg plans to issue Eurobonds worth up to $300 million for between two to five years.
The City of St Petersburg last month decided to postpone its planned Eurobond until it was able to study full details of a new 15 percent tax on earnings from government securities.
